notes:
T370 SESSION FINDINGS — task identity now reaches tools/runner: liveness distinguishes three real states, directives land in RUNNING runners, and the degraded no-identity mode warns loudly instead of running blind. Recorded in the T370 commit (see git log).

=== (1) THE DEFECT, CONFIRMED BY EXECUTION ===

untracked/heartbeat.jsonl held 2405 runner/<pid> beats (e.g. runner/15276, runner/2396) against 673 task-attributed beats. The dispatch wrappers (bin/subagent, bin/ollama-subagent) DID set MANAGENT_TASK_ID for task dispatches (since T278), but every console launched by hand — the brief-paste path the fleet actually uses — never had the variable, so every such runner invocation fell to the pid fallback. Two consequences confirmed live: `managent liveness` read T363/T366 as '[stale: no heartbeat recorded]' while their runners were at 100% CPU, and a `managent tell T363 <pause|kill>` could never match task_id 'runner/15276'.

=== (2) WHAT LANDED ===

1. tools/runner — identity resolution is now LOUD: a run with neither --task-id nor MANAGENT_TASK_ID prints a 5-line WARNING on stderr (liveness cannot attribute beats, directives cannot reach, heartbeats land under runner/<pid>, and the exact fix: export MANAGENT_TASK_ID=<task-id> or --task-id). An identified run prints 'task identity: <id> (source: --task-id|MANAGENT_TASK_ID)'. The mid-run directive poll is NEW: --directive-poll-s (default 10, 0=off) re-checks directives while the command executes; a pending pause/kill SIGKILLs the group and exits 124 naming the directive (id, directive, from). Launch-time check unchanged. Kill/wall/RSS semantics untouched (brief bar).

2. Launch sites: bin/subagent and bin/ollama-subagent already exported MANAGENT_TASK_ID on task dispatches (verified, kept); their --dry-run now prints the MANAGENT_TASK_ID line so propagation is visible. bin/managent claim now prints 'export MANAGENT_TASK_ID=<id> (so tools/runner heartbeats land under this task)' on every successful claim (both dispatchable and blocked branches) — the worker's FIRST action per the dispatch prompts is claim, so the hint lands where the console can copy it. docs/infra/runner.md, docs/infra/host/runner.md, docs/infra/delegation/DELEGATEE.md document the contract.

3. managent liveness — three distinct states per in_progress row, with beat count and threshold:
   - '[beating]  last beat Ns ago  (M beats)'
   - '[beats stopped Nm ago]  last beat <ts>  (M beats)' (sub-minute: 'Ns ago')
   - '[never beat since dispatch <claimed>]'
   Stale threshold default 5 min; --stale-min <float> or LIVENESS_STALE_MIN overrides. Beat count = runner-emitted heartbeats recorded under the task (one per [progress] line + one on exit). Shared ageSecFromTs() extracted to module level (deduped the copy that lived inside resume's closure).

=== (3) CONTROLS — every denominator ===

New tools/regression-task-identity.sh (standalone; NOT wired into build.zig — T369 owns build.zig per D038, so I did not touch it): 15/15 controls PASS.
  1. loud fallback: no-identity run warns, names runner/<pid>, names the fix (3 checks)
  2. heartbeat attribution: MANAGENT_TASK_ID=T370CTL lands a beat under the task (1)
  3. liveness states: never-beat / beating / beats-stopped / beat-count, seeded temp store (4)
  4. killed mid-run reads dead within one interval: real SIGKILL of the runner, still [beating] at +1s, [beats stopped] at +1 interval (3)
  5. directive at launch: pending kill -> runner exit 124 (1)
  6. directive mid-run: tell pause while running -> exit 124 (seeded); directive for a DIFFERENT task -> exit 0 (null) (2)
  7. claim prints the export instruction (1)
Regression-runner-reporting.sh: all controls PASS with the new warning (greps unaffected). regression-subagent-prompt.sh: all controls PASS (dry-run now carries MANAGENT_TASK_ID). zig build: exit 0. bin/managent resume + audit sanity: PASS on the live store and temp store.

=== (6) NOT DONE (state it plainly) ===

- The runner does NOT read MANAGENT_TASK_ID from a file; a console claimed by hand must export the variable itself (claim now prints the line). No mechanism can attribute a runner process to a row without SOME env/flag at launch — the brief's 'prefer exporting MANAGENT_TASK_ID on the child' is exactly this.
- Mid-run 'pause' SIGKILLs the group and exits 124 (same stop as the launch-time check); it does NOT SIGSTOP-and-resume. That matches the runner's existing 'fail loud, no graceful path' contract; noted so the seat does not expect a resumable pause.
- Live rows claimed before this fix have no runner-attributed beats until their next identified runner invocation; liveness shows them honestly as 'never beat since dispatch'.
- T364's parent-side exit record (a SIGKILLed runner writes no exit heartbeat) is T364's row, untouched here.
